title: Bobby D's Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Bobby D's is a 3 BR / 2.5 BA / 6 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. If you are looking for a place to enjoy the beach, nature, or beautiful views, Bobby D’s is just the place for you.
description_expanded: Description506 FOREST STREET2 KINGS, 1 QUEEN, 2 TWINSPlease be advised that there is construction located south of this home between Seaside and Watercolor for Seaside improvements, we apologize for this inconvenience. Construction completion date is Jan. 2026. Bobby D’s | A Luxury Seaside Cottage Surrounded by NatureTucked among lush greenery and mature trees, Bobby D’s offers a rare blend of coastal elegance and peaceful privacy in the heart of Seaside, Florida. This beautifully appointed two-story, four-bedroom retreat is just steps from the family pool, neighborhood parks, and Seaside Avenue, with East Ruskin Pavilion beach access only a five-minute walk away. While the setting feels serene and tucked away, you’re moments from everything that makes Seaside iconic.Outdoor Living & Arrival ExperienceGuests arrive to designated off-street parking directly in front of the home and are welcomed by a charming open-air front porch with two rocking chairs—an ideal spot for morning coffee or evening conversations. The porch overlooks a private, landscaped yard featuring a softly lit seating area and a tranquil fountain, creating a calming soundtrack to your stay.Open Living Spaces for Gathering & RelaxationInside, Bobby D’s opens to a spacious living room designed for connection and comfort. A large wraparound sectional and mounted flat-screen TV make it perfect for movie nights after long beach days. Natural light and thoughtful design create an inviting atmosphere that encourages guests to unwind together.Gourmet Kitchen & DiningThe renovated gourmet kitchen is a true standout, fully equipped for both everyday meals and special occasions. Features include upscale Viking appliances, a gas range with griddle, double ovens, icemaker, and beverage drawers. A high-top kitchen bar with additional seating and its own flat-screen TV keeps the entire group connected, while the adjacent dining area offers ample space for shared meals. A convenient half bath is located just off the kitchen on the main level.Main-Level Primary SuiteThe first-floor king primary suite provides a private retreat within the home. Thoughtfully designed with a chaise lounge seating area, large flat-screen TV, and custom built-in storage, the space is ideal for longer stays. The ensuite bathroom features dual vanities, a whirlpool soaking tub, and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower for spa-like relaxation.Upstairs Bedrooms & Musical LegacyAscending the staircase, guests discover the inspiration behind the home’s name. Bobby D’s is owned by legendary songwriter Bobby DiPiero, and the second floor celebrates his musical legacy with records and plaques throughout—some of his iconic songs were written right here.Upstairs includes three generously sized bedrooms:A secondary king primary suite with dual walk-in closets, flat-screen TV, and a private ensuite bath featuring dual vanities and a glass-enclosed walk-in showerA queen guest bedroom with ample storage and flat-screen TVA twin bedroom with two beds, private TV, and DVD player—perfect for younger guestsThe queen and twin rooms share a well-appointed hall bath with a tub/shower combination.Elevated Outdoor SpacesJust off the upstairs hallway, a furnished balcony overlooks Seaside’s treetops, offering a quiet perch for reading, afternoon cocktails, or unwinding under the stars. It’s the perfect complement to the home’s indoor living spaces.Your Seaside SanctuaryWhether you’re drawn to the beach, the peaceful natural surroundings, or the rich character woven into every detail, Bobby D’s delivers a refined Seaside experience rooted in luxury, comfort, and tranquility. From its prime location to its thoughtful design, this home invites you to relax deeply and return year after year.* 5 night minimum Spring, Spring Break & Summer; 3 night minimum Fall; 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES2,311 square feet of spacious, thoughtfully designed living spacePrivate Seaside residential beach access at East Ruskin PavilionSeaside features the largest private residential beach on Scenic 30A352 yards (4-minute walk) to beach accessOutdoor charcoal grill for casual cookoutsConveniently located near the family pool and playgroundTelevisions in every bedroomDeep soaking tub for relaxation after beach daysEnclosed outdoor showerGourmet, fully renovated kitchen featuring an icemaker and double ovensWasher and dryerPeacock Alley linens throughout the home, offering fresh, luxurious sheets and towelsAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest services throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking passes: 2 passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homes. Golf carts are considered vehicles. Golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside. Special circumstances and medical needs require an approved golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002237
